feeds.title: Cooking with Zahra
feeds.description: A culinary journey of delicious traditional Arabic and Iranian food by Zahra Abdalla.

feeds.title: The Caspian Chef
feeds.description: I am on a personal journey to share the love of my Iranian culture and heritage, bridging cultural gaps one tasty bite at a time and pursuing my lifelong dream of writing a memoir and a cookbook.

feeds.title: Unicorns in the Kitchen
feeds.description: Persian Recipes are always simple and easy to follow. The flavors are so enchantingly amazing, they would take you to a whole new world. Check out tasty and easy Persian food recipes here on Unicorns in the Kitchen

feeds.title: My Persian Kitchen
feeds.description: A cooking blog dedicated to Persian food. The purpose of this blog is to chronicle what happens in the kitchen during our Persian food cooking sessions. Additionally, we would like to display how delicious and healthy Persian cuisine is. Hopefully, we can inspire others to cook the dishes displayed.

feeds.title: Persian Mama
feeds.description: Persian Food, Desserts, Baking and Pastry Recipes with step-by-step instructions and illustrations by Homa Partovi.

feeds.title: Turmeric and Saffron
feeds.description: Persian Cuisine, Recipes and Stories by Azita Mehran, Author of the Persian food & culture blog 'Turmeric & Saffron' . Her mission is to show how flavorful and healthy Persian meals are and encourage everyone to try Persian home cooking at least once!

feeds.title: The Saffron Tales - Persian Food & Recipes by Yasmin Khan Blog
feeds.description: Explore the rich diversity of Persian cuisine in Yasmin Khan's acclaimed work, The Saffron Tales - authentic Persian recipes discovered first-hand inside Iran.

feeds.title: Foodcraftz
feeds.description: A food blog that contains delicious and diverse recipes from Italian, Iranian, Vegetarian to Ketogenic and low carb diet and soon much more! Bahareh was born and raised in Iran and lives in Italy for almost 15 years.

feeds.title: YummyNotes
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Samira. Cooking is the way I express my creative side to the world. Welcome to my Kitchen Corner on the Internet! My focus is on Mediterranean cuisine.

feeds.title: Cafe' Persia
feeds.description: Persian food & recipes by Massoud Nasseri.

feeds.title: My Little Persian Kitchen
feeds.description: A trailblazer of Persian cookery. Rebekah Jones was born in Coventry to a Persian father and an English mother. Rebekah lives in North Shropshire with her husband Darren and her little boy, Kasper. A self-taught cook and a Persian food enthusiast, Rebekah has a passion for bringing Persian and Middle Eastern food back.

feeds.title: Family Spice
feeds.description: Browse 500 family friendly recipes made with a Persian flair by recipe developer, author, speaker and mom Laura Bashar. If you can read it, you can cook it. I'll show you how!
